title: Lava Chicken To THE WORLD REVOLVING
description: This replaces the lava chickien, which SUCKS, with THE WORLD REVOLVING, by Toby Fox, which is my favorite song.
body: This pack replaces the TERRIBLE Lava chicken music with THE WORLD REVOVLING by Toby Fox. This is for the people who strongly dislike the lava chicken song and prefer THE WORLD RWVOLVING, which is the theme for Jevil, my favorite character
